name: Spiced Oysters
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Put the liquor into a porcelain kettle, and boil and skim it
When it has come to a hard boil, add the vinegar and put in the oysters with the seasoning of spices, &c.
Give them one boil up, for if boiled longer they will shrivel and lose their flavour
Put them into a stone or glass jar, cover them closely, and set them in a cool place
They must be quite cold when eaten
You may give them a light reddish tint by boiling in the liquor a little prepared cochineal

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put the liquor into a porcelain kettle, and boil and skim it
2. When it has come to a hard boil, add the vinegar and put in the oysters with the seasoning of spices, &c.
3. Give them one boil up, for if boiled longer they will shrivel and lose their flavour
4. Put them into a stone or glass jar, cover them closely, and set them in a cool place
5. They must be quite cold when eaten
6. You may give them a light reddish tint by boiling in the liquor a little prepared cochineal
